title: Pure Skilled Magician
summary: The Skilled Magician archetype unites the Level 4 Spell Counter apprentices—Skilled Dark Magician, Skilled White Magician, Skilled Blue Magician, Skilled Red Magician, and Skilled Brown Magician! Every Spell Card you activate places a Spell Counter on your Skilled Magicians; once a Skilled Magician holds 3 Spell Counters, you can Tribute it to Special Summon its iconic legendary master (Dark Magician, Buster Blader, Gaia The Fierce Knight, or Summoned Skull) directly from your hand, Deck, or GY! Better yet, Skilled Blue Magician and Skilled Red Magician banish themselves from your GY to place extra Spell Counters on your field, while Secrets of Dark Magic and Magicalized Fusion fuse the summoned Dark Magician and Buster Blader into Dark Paladin (Spell negate) or The Dark Magicians!

allow.Magicians' Souls: Mentions 'Dark Magician': sends Dark Magician from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself or Dark Magician, and sends extra Continuous/Field Spells to draw up to 2 cards!
allow.Magical Citadel of Endymion: Field Spell that gains a Spell Counter every time a Spell Card is activated and lets you remove Spell Counters from the Citadel instead of from your Skilled Magicians when Tributing them to summon Dark Magician, Buster Blader, or Summoned Skull!
allow.Spell Power Mastery: Normal Spell that places Spell Counters on your Skilled Magicians and searches another copy of Spell Power Mastery.
allow.Spell Power Grasp: Normal Spell that places 1 Spell Counter on a Skilled Magician (plus 1 for its own Spell activation = +2 Spell Counters from 1 card!) and searches a second Spell Power Grasp.
allow.Magicalized Fusion: Normal Spell that banishes Dark Magician + Buster Blader (or Skilled Magicians!) from your field or GY to Fusion Summon Dark Paladin, The Dark Magicians, or Quintet Magician!
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Magical Citadel of Endymion.
allow.Dark Paladin: Signature Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss ('Dark Magician' + 'Buster Blader'—the exact two monsters summoned from your Deck by Skilled Dark Magician and Skilled White Magician!): gains 500 ATK per Dragon on the field/GY and discards 1 card as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy ANY Spell Card!
allow.Archfiend's Manifestation: Level 6 Fusion ('Summoned Skull' + 1 DARK monster—summoned using Summoned Skull from Skilled Red Magician + any DARK Skilled Magician!).
allow.Quintet Magician: Level 12 Spellcaster Fusion boss (5 Spellcaster monsters; summoned via Magicalized Fusion) that destroys all cards your opponent controls when Fusion Summoned using 5 Spellcasters with different names!
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters and revives Skilled Magicians or Dark Magician from your GY.
allow.Crowley, the First Propheseer: Link-2 DARK Spellcaster made with any two Skilled Magicians.
allow.Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer: Rank 4 toolbox staple that spins any problematic face-up card into the Deck.
allow.Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack: Rank 7 Machine Xyz staple that generates Tokens and destroys opposing cards.

main: Skilled Dark Magician

Core Level 4 DARK Spellcaster (1900 ATK): gains 1 Spell Counter each time a Spell Card is activated (max. 3); tributes itself with 3 Spell Counters to Special Summon 1 'Dark Magician' from your hand, Deck, or GY!
Skilled White Magician

Core Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster (1700 ATK / 1900 DEF): gains 1 Spell Counter each time a Spell Card is activated (max. 3); tributes itself with 3 Spell Counters to Special Summon 1 'Buster Blader' from your hand, Deck, or GY!
Skilled Blue Magician

Core Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster (1800 ATK / 1800 DEF): gains 1 Spell Counter per Spell (max. 3) and tributes itself with 3 counters to summon 'Gaia The Fierce Knight' from hand, Deck, or GY; and banishes itself from your GY during your Main Phase to place 1 Spell Counter on a card you control!
Skilled Red Magician

Core Level 4 DARK Spellcaster (1600 ATK / 1600 DEF): gains 1 Spell Counter per Spell (max. 3) and tributes itself with 3 counters to Special Summon 1 'Archfiend' monster (Summoned Skull!) from your hand, Deck, or GY; and banishes itself from your GY to place 1 Spell Counter on a card you control!
Skilled Brown Magician

Level 4 EARTH Spellcaster: gains 1 Spell Counter per Spell (max. 3) and removes 1 Spell Counter to either gain 1500 ATK (reaching 1800 ATK) + 1 Level OR add 1 'Kuriboh' monster from your Deck/GY to your hand.
Dark Magician
Summoned directly from your hand, Deck, or GY by Tributing Skilled Dark Magician; fuses with Buster Blader into Dark Paladin or with any Skilled Magician into The Dark Magicians!
Buster Blader
Summoned directly from your hand, Deck, or GY by Tributing Skilled White Magician; gains 500 ATK per Dragon and fuses with Dark Magician into Dark Paladin!
Summoned Skull
Always treated as an 'Archfiend' card: summoned directly from your hand, Deck, or GY by Tributing Skilled Red Magician!
Gaia The Fierce Knight
Summoned directly from your hand, Deck, or GY by Tributing Skilled Blue Magician.
Magicians' Souls
Mentions 'Dark Magician': sends Dark Magician from your Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself or Dark Magician, and sends extra Continuous/Field Spells to draw up to 2 cards!
Magical Citadel of Endymion

Core Field Spell: gains a Spell Counter every time a Spell is activated, and lets you remove 3 Spell Counters from Magical Citadel instead of from your Skilled Magicians when Tributing them to summon Dark Magician, Buster Blader, or Summoned Skull!
Spell Power Grasp
Places 1 Spell Counter on a Skilled Magician (plus 1 for activating a Spell = 2 Spell Counters instantly!) and adds another Spell Power Grasp from your Deck to your hand.
Spell Power Mastery
Places Spell Counters on your Skilled Magicians and searches another copy of Spell Power Mastery.
Secrets of Dark Magic
Quick-Play Spell that Fusion Summons Dark Paladin or The Dark Magicians using Dark Magician or Dark Magician Girl from your hand or field!
Magicalized Fusion
Banishes Dark Magician + Buster Blader (or 5 different-name Skilled Magicians!) from your field or GY to Fusion Summon Dark Paladin, The Dark Magicians, or Quintet Magician!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Magical Citadel of Endymion.
extra: Signature Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss ('Dark Magician' + 'Buster Blader'; 2900 ATK): assembled by Tributing Skilled Dark Magician + Skilled White Magician and fusing via Secrets of Dark Magic or Magicalized Fusion; discards 1 card as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy ANY Spell Card!

Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss ('Dark Magician' + 1 Spellcaster monster: Dark Magician + any Skilled Magician!): draws 1 card once per turn whenever a Spell or Trap Card is activated (and if it's a Spell/Trap, you can Set it and activate it this turn!).

Level 12 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss (5 Spellcaster monsters; summoned via Magicalized Fusion using your 5 different Skilled Magicians in the GY!): destroys all cards your opponent controls on Fusion Summon and cannot be Tributed or destroyed by card effects!
Level 6 DARK Fiend Fusion ('Summoned Skull' + 1 DARK monster) made using Summoned Skull (summoned by Skilled Red Magician) + Skilled Dark/Red Magician.
Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster that generates Spell Counters for your Skilled Magicians and revives Dark Magician or any Skilled Magician from your GY.
Link-2 DARK Spellcaster made with any two Skilled Magicians.
Rank 7: detaches 1 material to target and take permanent control of 1 opponent's monster.
Rank 4: detaches 2 materials to shuffle any face-up card on the field into the Deck.
Rank 7: detaches 1 material to summon 2 Tokens; indestructible while controlling Tokens; tributes a Token to destroy a card on field.
